integrity: The universal argument is analytic. Finite checks at two prime dimensions corroborate, but do not establish, the quantified theorem. Known Alltop-MUB existence and the recent MUB-to-magic purity count are treated as prior work rather than claimed contributions.
scientific_limitations: The theorem supplies an explicit cubic Alltop family and its exact bipartite Schmidt spectrum for prime local dimension at least five. It does not prove the conjectured global maximality of the displayed stabilizer Rényi entropy, classify all maximizers, or cover local dimensions two or three.
title: Exact Schmidt spectrum of cubic Alltop two-qudit states
